script: This proves NBA players are just on another level. Kosta Koufos was challenged to take on 30 average hoopers, and a lot of people thought he might lose since he had already been retired for years. But instead, he started picking them apart one after another, and most of them couldn't even score a single point on him. The craziest part is he even knocked down multiple threes in a row, even though he only made one 3-pointer in his entire NBA career, which is fewer than Ben Simmons. And before you say they weren't taking it seriously, there was $5,000 up for grabs. But after all those matchups, not one of them could take down Kosta.
what_makes_it_work: High-contrast premise between a retired pro and average players
Fast pacing with continuous action cuts
